methods.what: Separation of variables giving modified Bessel equation of order zero for radial part
Power series solution of radial equation (series for I_0(mu r))
Integral representation of Bessel function via generating-function exponential
Substitution transforming the integral of f into an integral over s with square-root kernel (axisymmetric potential representation)
Potential as integral between complex endpoints eta = z+ri, eta' = z-ri
